title: EvoShield Design Intern
note: Protective gear design for youth baseball and softball players; interest in the sports is a plus.

facts.duties: Research teen baseball and softball players; develop elbow and leg guard concepts; review colorway and CMF trends; work through sample rounds and a limited-edition prototype with the factory.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's student in industrial design or design research; Illustrator; portfolio showing visual communication and research.
facts.apply: Apply online on Wilson's iCIMS careers site, job 2026-5232.
